source_text: Sanctuarium, Domine, quod praeparaverunt manus tuae. Non humanum templum solum, sed corpus Christi et ecclesia. Manus Domini fabricant.
pass_a_gloss: Sanctuary, Lord, which prepared hands your. Not human temple only, but body of-Christ and church. Hands of-Lord fashion.
pass_b_english: [[The sanctuary, O Lord, which your hands prepared >> Bible:Exodus 15:17]]. Not only a human temple, but Christ’s body and the church. The Lord’s hands do the building.
